description: A generic Copy-activity stand-in: moves data from one cloud-storage (or local) path to another (single file, or every file matching a wildcard pattern), or into a warehouse table. copy_mode=binary does a raw byte-stream copy; copy_mode=dataframe reads/writes with format conversion or loads a warehouse table.

source_path.label: Source Path
source_path.description: Source fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfss://..., or a local/plain path). '{partition_key}' is replaced with the running partition. When `wildcard` is set, this is treated as a DIRECTORY (not a single file) that `wildcard` is matched under.

wildcard.label: Wildcard
wildcard.description: Glob pattern (e.g. '*.csv') matched under source_path, which is then treated as a directory. Every matching file is binary-copied to the same relative path under sink_path -- the common 'copy everything matching *.csv in this folder' same-format file copy. Requires copy_mode='binary' and sink_path (not sink_table); leave unset for the default single-file source_path -> sink_path/sink_table copy.

recursive.label: Recursive
recursive.description: wildcard only. Match files in subdirectories under source_path too (equivalent to a '**/' prefix on wildcard).

copy_mode.label: Copy Mode
copy_mode.description: 'binary' (default): a raw byte-stream copy, no parsing -- matches ADF's default Binary dataset type, the shape most real file-to-file Copy activities actually use. 'dataframe': read the source into a DataFrame and either write it out in a (possibly different) file format, or load it into a warehouse table via sink_table. Required (not binary) when sink_table is set, or when sink_format differs from the source's real format.

source_format.label: Source Format
source_format.description: copy_mode='dataframe' only. 'auto' detects from source_path's extension.

sink_path.label: Sink Path
sink_path.description: File sink: fsspec URI ('{partition_key}' templated). Exactly one of sink_path / sink_table must be set.

sink_format.label: Sink Format
sink_format.description: copy_mode='dataframe' + sink_path only (required then). Ignored for copy_mode='binary' -- bytes are written verbatim, no re-serialization.

sink_table.label: Sink Table
sink_table.description: Warehouse-table sink (requires copy_mode='dataframe'). Keys: resource_key (required), table (required), schema, if_exists: append|replace (default append), mode: upsert_on_match (partition-rewrite idempotent DELETE-then-INSERT keyed by match), match: [col, ...] (required for upsert_on_match). Auto-detects DuckDB's .register() fast path; falls back to SQLAlchemy to_sql. Exactly one of sink_path / sink_table must be set.

azure_account_name_env_var.label: Azure Account Name Env Var
azure_account_name_env_var.description: Only used when source_path or sink_path is an abfs://.../abfss://... URI.

azure_account_key_env_var.label: Azure Account Key Env Var
azure_account_key_env_var.description: Only used when source_path or sink_path is an abfs://.../abfss://... URI (ignored if azure_connection_string_env_var is also set).

azure_connection_string_env_var.label: Azure Connection String Env Var
azure_connection_string_env_var.description: Only used when source_path or sink_path is an abfs://.../abfss://... URI. Takes precedence over azure_account_key_env_var.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Log what would be copied and skip touching source/sink entirely.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys for lineage.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners -- team names ('team:analytics') or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog. Auto-includes 'cloud-storage' if empty.

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: 0 (default): a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows. 1: include the current, in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying partitions definition (defaults to UTC).

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.

pool.label: Pool
pool.description: Dagster's native named concurrency pool -- a cap on concurrent copies sharing the same pool name.
